name: Creamed Lobster
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Take the meat lobster, chop it fine, add whipped cream, gelatine which has been soaked in water, a little anchovy sauce, salt and cayenne
Stir it gently till nearly set, and pour into a slightly oiled border mould
When turned out, fill the centre with mayonnaise, garnish with mashed green peas put through a forcepipe, and the claws round the outside

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Take the meat lobster, chop it fine, add whipped cream, gelatine which has been soaked in water, a little anchovy sauce, salt and cayenne
2. Stir it gently till nearly set, and pour into a slightly oiled border mould
3. When turned out, fill the centre with mayonnaise, garnish with mashed green peas put through a forcepipe, and the claws round the outside
